content.short: QuillShield is a Web3 DevSecOps platform providing security solutions for the smart contract lifecycle, including AI-driven security audits.
content.description: QuillShield is a comprehensive Web3 DevSecOps platform that delivers security solutions for the full lifecycle of smart contracts, from development through post-deployment. It currently centers on AI-driven security audits designed to strengthen the integrity and resilience of smart contracts. By integrating these audits into the lifecycle, QuillShield helps teams maintain robust contract security as projects evolve and scale. The emphasis on AI-driven auditing reflects a focus on automated, scalable review to support secure development and resilient deployments.
